    rows = [p[0] for p in b]
    cols = [p[1] for p in b]
    cr, cc = sum(rows)//len(rows), sum(cols)//len(cols)
    print(f"  Sky blue at ({cr}, {cc}), pixels={n['pixels']}")

    b = n['boundary']

    cols = [p[1] for p in b]
    cr, cc = sum(rows)//len(rows), sum(cols)//len(cols)
    print(f"\nClicking sky blue at ({cr}, {cc})")
    result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': cr, 'col': cc}])

    colors = {}

    print(f"Colors after: {colors}")

    cr, cc = sum(rows)//len(rows), sum(cols)//len(cols)
    cross_positions.append((cr, cc))
